annotations.title: Find an Iranian law by name

description: Find Iranian laws and regulations by their title, or part of it, in Dadras's library: up to 10 matches, best first, each with its slug, number of articles and dadrasai.com page. Use it when the user names a law («قانون صدور چک», «مدنی») and its exact title or slug is needed, before list_law_articles. It matches title words only; to find what laws say about a subject, use search_iranian_law.

name.description: All or part of the law's Persian title; a distinctive word works best, e.g. «مدنی» or «صدور چک».

name: find_law

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.

title: Find an Iranian law by name
